eps.o: After surviving the murder of her mother as a child, a young Bronx woman grows up to become a victim's advocate; when her dismembered body is found in a park, the community is stunned.

Two friends disappear during a shopping trip and when they're found brutally murdered days later, stunning secrets and shocking theories about an affair begin to emerge; law enforcement must race to find their killer and bring them to justice.
When a nurse is abducted outside of her workplace, police race to locate her; but hope fades when video is uncovered of a mysterious man cleaning out her car and the woman nowhere to be seen.

When an empty nester and healthcare worker disappears in the middle of the COVID-19 pandemic, her family fears something tragic has happened; detectives uncover a suspect whose deadly past may be repeating itself.

A young mother and former drug dealer decides to leave the criminal world behind, only to end up murdered; at first, it appears her past may have caught up with her, but a witness soon reveals a betrayal and a motive that's far more personal.

A husband returns home and finds his wife stabbed to death with a message written in blood beside her body - You're next. Was she murdered by a rival gang seeking revenge, or is the cryptic threat really a cover for a killer hiding in plain sight?

When a hard-working Liberian immigrant is found brutally murdered, her family is left reeling. But investigators soon uncover a secret that may have led to her death. With the trail going cold, will they find the killer before they disappear for good?

A young woman with special needs is found dead by her boyfriend, who tells police she was beaten by a group of women. Detectives investigate if she was a victim of bullying until a bombshell discovery in her autopsy leads them straight to her killer.

When a man is found dead in his burning apartment, his girlfriend admits that he had been selling drugs to make more money. To detectives all signs point to a possible rival drug dealer, but will secrets come to light to reveal a more personal motive?

A mother is fatally stabbed, and her boyfriend is gravely wounded by an alleged attacker right outside her home. Is this a random act of violence, or is it possible the killer wanted her dead and went to unfathomable lengths to cover their tracks?

When a single mother and nurse is found shot in her car, police look to her bitter ex-wife and current girlfriend with rumored anger issues for answers. Will detectives uncover a love triangle gone wrong, or will a more sinister motive be revealed?

Police get a frantic call that a young woman has been shot. The victim dies before she can tell them what happened, and the mystery caller is nowhere to be found. As detectives investigate, an unlikely phone call could be the breakthrough they need.

Stacey Jones was a single mom who finally found someone to settle down with. But as the new couple prepares to welcome a baby together, Stacey is gunned down. Was this a devastating hate crime or will detectives discover a shocking motive for murder?

When a loving single mother is murdered in her own apartment in Essex, MD, police suspect her ex-boyfriend. The case becomes complicated when detectives uncover a potential new suspect, and it will take a high-speed chase through the city to bring the killer to justice.

When a single mother is found beaten, strangled, and stabbed to death in her Houston apartment, police suspect the killer is someone she knew. Was this a custody battle that turned deadly or will a shocking secret reveal a more disturbing motive?

A man who struggled with addiction and mental health is found decomposing in a hotel room after surviving a hurricane. Detectives wonder if he succumbed to his past, but his autopsy tells a different story in a confession turns the case on its head.

A beloved teacher is nowhere to be found when her young daughter is discovered wandering in a parking lot; when detectives learn information about her love life, they must piece together her last moments to uncover the truth.
